_comment: Subset of the bank-automation v2.0 private-config used by the statements workflow. Copy to private-config.json and fill in real values. NEVER commit private-config.json. PDF passwords do not go here: they live in statement-passwords.json ({"<account key>": "password"}).
_match_help: match = a rule or a list of rules (any may match). Per rule, all case-insensitive: from/to = substring of sender/recipient, subject/filename = regex. Empty fields are ignored; all non-empty fields must match; a rule with none never matches. Optional per-account 'key' sets the id used by the sidecar; default is <bank>.<slug(name)>. 'link' is for statements emailed as a download link: only links on allow_hosts are followed, and only a real PDF is accepted; filename rules cannot apply to those emails.
